source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original upgrade aligns runtime and BaseApp variables at 25.08 and changes the builder image to Freedesktop 25.08. Repack uses those variables for BaseApp installation and runtime/SDK/base metadata. Accepted source retains the package versions but later chooses a pinned linter container. Keep the package environment separate from the image that builds it; source values do not prove external compatibility or a successful package.
title: Flatpak runtime, SDK and BaseApp versions are consumed separately from the builder image
